name: wifi_monitor
description: Full WiFi pentesting toolkit: wifite-style automation, full aircrack-ng suite, injection, evil-twin, MITM, WPS, PMKID, WEP attacks, auto-crack pipeline, and LAN scanning
author: 0xb0rn3 | github.com/0xb0rn3

optional_dependencies.aircrack-ng: Monitor mode, handshake capture, injection, WEP/WPA cracking
optional_dependencies.dnsmasq: DHCP server for evil-twin / captive portal
optional_dependencies.scapy: ARP host discovery — pip3 install scapy (requires root)
optional_dependencies.aiohttp: Async CVE lookup via cve.circl.lu — pip3 install aiohttp

help.description: Merges the full wifite automation pipeline and aircrack-ng suite into one secV module. Supports passive WiFi scanning, monitor mode management, packet injection, handshake capture, WEP attacks, PMKID capture, WPS Pixie-Dust/PIN, evil-twin with captive portal, ARP-MITM, cracking (aircrack-ng / hashcat / airolib), traffic decryption, raw packet forge/injection, and original LAN host-discovery with port scanning and CVE enrichment. All WiFi operations require a monitor-capable wireless interface and root/sudo.

auto.description: wifite-style full-auto pipeline: monitor_on → wifi_scan → rank by signal → per-AP: WEP/PMKID/capture+deauth/WPS → auto_crack

monitor_on.description: Enable monitor mode via airmon-ng (with interfering-process kill) or iw fallback

monitor_off.description: Restore managed mode and restart NetworkManager

inject_test.description: Test packet injection capability with aireplay-ng --test, reports ACK count

wifi_scan.description: Passive AP and client discovery via airodump-ng CSV; ranked by signal strength

capture.description: WPA/WPA2 4-way handshake capture with staggered deauth waves

handshake_check.description: Verify that a .cap file contains a valid WPA handshake using aircrack-ng

wep_attack.description: WEP attack: fake-auth + ARP-replay / chop-chop / fragmentation / caffe-latte, then auto-crack

forge_packet.description: Craft a raw ARP packet with packetforge-ng and inject it with aireplay-ng --interactive

evil_twin.description: Rogue AP (hostapd + dnsmasq DHCP); optional embedded captive-portal server that captures submitted passwords

mitm.description: ARP-poisoning MITM via bettercap (preferred, with SSL-strip) or arpspoof; tcpdump pcap capture

wps_scan.description: Enumerate WPS-enabled APs with wash; reports locked/unlocked status

wps_attack.description: WPS Pixie-Dust and/or PIN brute-force via reaver; bully as fallback

pmkid.description: Clientless PMKID capture with hcxdumptool; auto-converts to .hc22000 for hashcat

crack.description: Crack .cap / .hc22000 files using aircrack-ng, hashcat (GPU), or airolib precomputed PMK DB

auto_crack.description: Multi-method crack pipeline: airolib PMK DB → aircrack-ng → hashcat (auto-converts .cap to .hc22000)

decrypt.description: Decrypt captured WPA or WEP traffic with airdecap-ng given the known key/passphrase

airolib.description: Manage an airolib-ng precomputed PMK database: init, import ESSID, import wordlist, batch-compute PMKs, show stats

scan.description: LAN host discovery (ARP via scapy / TCP-ping fallback) + async port scanning, banner grab, CVE lookup

discover.description: LAN host discovery only — no port scan

check_tools.description: Report which external tools are installed, grouped by function

examples: shell          — reverse shell handler with optional evil-twin payload delivery

iface.description: Wireless interface name (e.g. wlan0, wlan0mon). Used as 'target' for WiFi modes.

bssid.required: for capture, deauth, wep_attack, wps_attack, pmkid

channel.description: WiFi channel number (1–14 for 2.4 GHz, 36–165 for 5 GHz)

wordlist.description: Absolute path to a wordlist/dictionary file for cracking
wordlist.required: for crack (aircrack-ng path), optional for auto/auto_crack

deauth.description: Send deauth frames during handshake capture to force reconnects

deauth_count.description: Number of deauth frames per wave (0 = continuous flood in deauth mode)

client_mac.description: Target client MAC for directed deauth (default FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF = broadcast)

victim.description: Victim IP for MITM ARP poisoning

gateway.description: Gateway IP for MITM ARP poisoning

strip_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS proxy / SSL stripping in bettercap MITM

capture.description: Write pcap during MITM session via tcpdump

password.description: WPA2 passphrase for evil-twin AP (omit for open AP)

captive_portal.description: Launch embedded captive-portal HTTP server; captured credentials saved to ~/.secv/wifi/evil_twin/

captive_port.description: TCP port for the captive portal HTTP server

ap_ip.description: IP address assigned to the rogue AP interface

with_dhcp.description: Start dnsmasq DHCP server alongside evil-twin AP

pixiedust.description: Use WPS Pixie-Dust attack (-K 1) in reaver

wps_pin.description: Known/guessed 8-digit WPS PIN to try directly

use_hashcat.description: Force hashcat even for .cap files (auto-converts to .hc22000)

airolib_db.description: Path to airolib-ng SQLite database of precomputed PMKs
airolib_db.required: for airolib mode; optional for crack/auto_crack

hashcat_rules.description: Path to a hashcat rules file (.rule) for rule-based mutations

key.description: WPA passphrase or WEP hex key for traffic decryption (decrypt mode)

wep.description: Treat key as a WEP key in decrypt mode (default: WPA)

smac.description: Source MAC address for forged packet

dmac.description: Destination MAC address for forged packet

arp_ip.description: Destination IP embedded in forged ARP packet

repeat.description: Number of times to inject the forged packet

xor_file.description: Path to .xor keystream file from chop-chop/fragment attack for packet forging

scan_duration.description: Seconds to scan for APs in auto mode

attack_timeout.description: Max seconds to spend per-target in auto mode

min_signal.description: Minimum signal strength (dBm) to include a target in auto mode

skip_wep.description: Skip WEP targets in auto mode

skip_wps.description: Skip WPS attacks in auto mode

interval.description: Deauth frame interval in seconds (0 = as fast as possible)

target.description: For scan/discover: CIDR range or single IP. For WiFi modes: used as iface if iface param absent.

ports.description: Ports to scan — comma-separated or range (e.g. '22,80,443' or '1-1024'). 'default' uses a 23-port common set.

port_scan.description: Run async port scan on discovered LAN hosts

cve_lookup.description: Look up CVEs via CIRCL API based on service banners

concurrency.description: Concurrent port probe workers per LAN host

lhost.description: Attacker IP for LHOST (auto-detected if omitted)

deliver_via_evil_twin.description: Serve payload over HTTP via evil-twin captive portal on port 8080

examples.description: Full-auto attack all nearby WPA/WPA2/WEP networks
Scan for APs and rank by signal
Clientless PMKID capture against one AP
ARP-MITM with bettercap and SSL stripping
Build airolib PMK database and crack
Decrypt captured WPA traffic after cracking
LAN scan: discover hosts, open ports, CVE lookup
Check which WiFi tools are installed
Shell handler with evil-twin delivery on FreeWiFi

features: wifite-style op_auto: monitor → scan → rank → WEP/PMKID/handshake/WPS → crack pipeline
Full aircrack-ng suite: airmon-ng, airodump-ng, aireplay-ng, aircrack-ng, airdecap-ng, airolib-ng, packetforge-ng
Clientless PMKID capture via hcxdumptool with auto-conversion to .hc22000
GPU cracking via hashcat -m 22000 with optional rules file
Precomputed PMK tables via airolib-ng (init, import essid/passwd, batch, stats)
Auto-crack pipeline: airolib → aircrack-ng → hashcat in order
WEP attacks: fake-auth + arp_replay / chopchop / fragment / caffe_latte
Raw packet forge and injection via packetforge-ng + aireplay-ng --interactive
Evil-twin rogue AP (hostapd + dnsmasq DHCP) with embedded captive portal
ARP-MITM via bettercap (preferred, SSL strip) or arpspoof with tcpdump capture
WPS Pixie-Dust and PIN brute-force via reaver; bully fallback
Traffic decryption of WPA/WEP captures via airdecap-ng
LAN host discovery: ARP (scapy) with TCP-ping fallback
Async port scanning with banner grabbing (HTTP/HTTPS/SSH/generic)
Device fingerprinting: IoT, router, NAS, DB server, web server
CVE lookup via CIRCL cve.circl.lu API with 24-hour cache
Threat detection: exposed databases, cleartext protocols, legacy SSH

tool_requirements.required_for_wifi: aircrack-ng suite (pacman -S aircrack-ng / apt install aircrack-ng)
tool_requirements.required_for_pmkid: hcxtools (pacman -S hcxtools / apt install hcxdumptool hcxtools)
tool_requirements.required_for_mitm: bettercap or dsniff (pacman -S bettercap / apt install dsniff)

notes: AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED: Only attack networks you own or have explicit written permission to test
All WiFi attack modes require root/sudo and a monitor-capable wireless adapter
Run monitor_on before wifi_scan, capture, pmkid, wep_attack, wps_attack, and deauth
evil_twin requires a second interface (not the one in monitor mode) or a USB WiFi adapter
Captive portal credential file path is printed in the response credential_file field
PMKID attack is clientless — no clients need to be connected to the target AP
hashcat cracking requires a GPU; use aircrack-ng on CPU-only systems
